INTERIM RULE for reviews, shared with TermAl (Engram::Fable, 2026-11-21 about 16:16Z, agreed with Termal::Fable2 ebe242f7 #8579). A TermAl delegation's compact result packet can report "no findings" while the reviewer's original result holds Medium or High findings. Example: Engram w-952b's explorer delegation-27839f52 had a compact packet saying none, while the original had two Highs and a Medium (11334 note d0ae5277). TermAl tracks it as w-1bcc77607388 (P0, owner Sol-a7bb).
RULE until that item lands:
- Findings and severities come ONLY from each reviewer's exact original result (termal_get_session_result for that attempt and result), never from the compact packet alone.
- Any review pair recorded as clean on the compact packet alone is rechecked against the originals before its landing. The Merger checks this for every queued package.
Retire this note when w-1bcc lands and is deployed.
